logger.message: Shipping System API Request - Method: #[attributes.method] URI: #[attributes.requestUri] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Request

logger.message: Shipping System API Error - Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId] Error: #[error.description]
logger.doc:name: Log Error

logger.message: Shipping provider connectivity error - Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Connectivity Error

logger.message: Shipping provider bad request - Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId] Response: #[payload]
logger.doc:name: Log Bad Request

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "shipmentId": payload.trackingNumber, "orderId": vars.originalPayload.orderId, "status": "CREATED", "trackingNumber": payload.trackingNumber, "carrier": payload.carrier default "STANDARD_CARRIER", "service": payload.serviceType default "STANDARD", "estimatedDeliveryDate": payload.estimatedDeliveryDate, "cost": { "amount": payload.cost.amount, "currency": payload.cost.currency default "USD" }, "createdDate": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"}, "correlationId": vars.correlationId }

logger.message: Shipment created successfully - Shipment ID: #[payload.shipmentId] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Success

logger.message: Getting shipment status - Shipment ID: #[vars.shipmentId] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Request

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "shipmentId": vars.shipmentId, "orderId": payload.orderReference, "status": upper(payload.status) match { case "CREATED" -> "CREATED" case "PICKED_UP" -> "IN_TRANSIT" case "IN_TRANSIT" -> "IN_TRANSIT" case "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" -> "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" case "DELIVERED" -> "DELIVERED" case "FAILED" -> "FAILED" else -> "UNKNOWN" }, "trackingNumber": payload.trackingNumber, "carrier": payload.carrier, "service": payload.serviceType, "estimatedDeliveryDate": payload.estimatedDeliveryDate, "actualDeliveryDate": payload.actualDeliveryDate, "trackingEvents": payload.events map (event, index) -> { "timestamp": event.timestamp, "status": event.status, "location": event.location, "description": event.description }, "lastUpdated": payload.lastUpdated default (now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"}), "correlationId": vars.correlationId }

logger.message: Shipment status retrieved - Shipment ID: #[vars.shipmentId] Status: #[payload.status] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Success

logger.message: Updating shipment - Shipment ID: #[vars.shipmentId] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId] Payload: #[payload]
logger.doc:name: Log Update Request

logger.message: Invalid update request - Shipment ID: #[vars.shipmentId] Error: #[payload]
logger.doc:name: Log Bad Request

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { shipmentId: vars.shipmentId, status: payload.status default vars.updateRequest.status, lastUpdated: payload.lastUpdated default (now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"}), message: "Shipment updated successfully", updatedFields: { (status: vars.updateRequest.status) if vars.updateRequest.status?, (deliveryInstructions: vars.updateRequest.deliveryInstructions) if vars.updateRequest.deliveryInstructions?, (destinationAddress: vars.updateRequest.destinationAddress) if vars.updateRequest.destinationAddress? }, correlationId: vars.correlationId }

logger.message: Shipment updated successfully - Shipment ID: #[vars.shipmentId] Status: #[payload.status] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Update Success

logger.message: Cancelling shipment - Shipment ID: #[vars.shipmentId] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Request

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "shipmentId": vars.shipmentId, "status": "CANCELLED", "cancelledAt": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"}, "message": "Shipment cancelled successfully", "correlationId": vars.correlationId }

logger.message: Shipment cancelled successfully - Shipment ID: #[vars.shipmentId] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Cancel Success

logger.message: Getting shipping rates - Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId] Payload: #[payload]
logger.doc:name: Log Rates Request

logger.message: Shipping rates retrieved - Found #[sizeOf(payload.rates)] rates - Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Rates Success

logger.message: Shipping rates request failed - Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId] Error: #[error.description]
logger.doc:name: Log Rates Error

logger.message: Tracking package - Tracking Number: #[vars.trackingNumber] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Track Request

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "trackingNumber": vars.trackingNumber, "shipmentId": payload.shipmentId default null, "currentStatus": upper(payload.status) match { case "LABEL_CREATED" -> "CREATED" case "PICKED_UP" -> "IN_TRANSIT" case "IN_TRANSIT" -> "IN_TRANSIT" case "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" -> "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" case "DELIVERED" -> "DELIVERED" case "DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED" -> "DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED" case "EXCEPTION" -> "EXCEPTION" case "RETURNED" -> "RETURNED" else -> "UNKNOWN" }, "estimatedDelivery": payload.estimatedDeliveryDate, "lastUpdateTime": payload.lastUpdated default (now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ"}), "currentLocation": { "city": payload.currentLocation.city default null, "state": payload.currentLocation.state default null, "country": payload.currentLocation.country default null, "facilityName": payload.currentLocation.facility default null }, "carrier": { "name": payload.carrier default "Unknown", "serviceType": payload.serviceType default null }, "trackingEvents": (payload.events default []) map (event, index) -> { "eventId": event.id default "EVT-" ++ index as String, "eventType": event.type, "eventDate": event.timestamp, "location": event.location, "description": event.description }, "correlationId": vars.correlationId }

logger.message: Package tracking retrieved - Tracking Number: #[vars.trackingNumber] Status: #[payload.currentStatus] Correlation ID: #[vars.correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Track Success
